steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Fact: Audience targeting is how media producers identify, reach, and appeal to specific groups of consumers. It is central to media marketing and commercial success. | Key Fact: Demographics classify audiences by objective, measurable characteristics: age, gender, income, occupation, education, ethnicity, and location. | Key Fact: Socio-economic grading (ABC1/C2DE): A (upper middle), B (middle), C1 (lower middle), C2 (skilled working), D (working), E (non-working). Used by advertisers to target by income and class. | Key Fact: Psychographics classify audiences by personality, values, attitudes, interests, and lifestyle. Young and Rubicam's 4Cs: Mainstreamers (security), Aspirers (status), Explorers (discovery), Reformers (social change).
